# Data model: 002-cms-conteudo
<!-- Generated by /speckit.plan Phase 1 -->

Thirteen collections. Every field traces to a page spec's *Modelo de conteúdo* table; nothing
here is invented. Labels are PT-BR (constitution Principle 4: content PT-BR, code English).

## Scope declarations

Every entry below joins `SCOPE_REGISTRY` with a one-line `why`, or `registry.test.ts` fails.

| Collection | Scope | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `projeto` `modelo3d` `aula` `artigo` `evento` | scoped | Content belongs to the lab that made it |
| `categoriaProjeto` `categoriaArtigo` `categoriaModelo` | scoped | A second lab names its own vocabulary; a global set would impose CITe's |
| `local` `maquina` | scoped | Physical resources of one lab |
| `perfilMaker` | scoped | Level, XP and skills are per-organization — one login, two profiles (CLR-002) |
| `curtida` | scoped | Joins a user to scoped content; the content side decides the tenant |
| `progressoAula` | scoped | Per-user progress against one lab's class |
| `usuario` | **global** | Unchanged from feature 000 — identity is platform-wide, role is per membership |

## Relationships that need `sameTenant`

Every relationship whose *target* is scoped carries `validate: sameTenant`:

`projeto.categoria` · `projeto.maquinasUtilizadas` · `projeto.autor→perfilMaker` ·
`modelo3d.categoria` · `modelo3d.autor` · `aula.autor` · `artigo.categoria` · `artigo.autor` ·
`evento.local` · `evento.maquinas` · `evento.responsavel` · `evento.aulasPrerequisito` ·
`evento.projetosGerados` · `curtida.*` · `progressoAula.aula` · `perfilMaker.usuario` (→ global,
so **no** validator — the target has no tenant to compare)

## Review queue

`status: rascunho | em_revisao | publicado`, on `projeto`, `modelo3d`, `aula`, `artigo`.
`evento` uses its own set (`rascunho · publicado · cancelado · concluido`) per `calendario.md`.

`aprovadoEm` (date) and `aprovacaoRegistrada` (boolean) are the idempotent stamp CLR-001
requires: set once on first entry to `publicado`, never cleared, so republishing cannot credit
twice when feature 005 reads them.

## Derived values

| Field | Derived from | When |
|---|---|---|
| `curtidas` | count of `curtida` rows | same transaction as the like |
| `downloads` | increments | same transaction as the download |
| `totalModelos` on a category | count of `modelo3d` rows | same transaction as publish/unpublish |
| `formatos` on `modelo3d` | extensions of `arquivosModelo` | on save |

All four follow **one** strategy — see plan § Sketch 7.

## Upload fields

| Group | Extensions | Cap |
|---|---|---|
| Images | `.jpg .jpeg .png .webp .svg` | 10 MB |
| 3D meshes | `.stl .3mf .obj .gltf .glb` | 100 MB |
| Documents / archives | `.pdf .zip .svg .dxf` | 200 MB |

Caps are `tech-stack.md` § Storage's, not the plan's invention, and Caddy needs a matching
`client_max_body_size`.
